D.treatment: group final projects in the Lasers Course

result.effect: 85% of students described at least three instances of peer interaction

cells.quote: We found 85% of students described at least three instances of peer interaction, which reinforces the the level of agreement with POS item 9 (“. . . I actively sought advice and support”).
cells.note: The study reports a descriptive qualitative finding without a comparison condition; coding reliability was 84% agreement and Cohen’s kappa was 0.67.
